name: Custom GPT Portfolio
description: Inventory for published, draft, archived, and planned Custom GPTs connected to AI Agent Library assets.

items.name: Ad Spend Cash Flow Calculator
items.one_sentence_description: Forecasts ecommerce ad spend cash flow, payout lag, cash gaps, and scale/fund decisions.
items.main_pain_solved: Ad spend can create a cash gap before revenue, margin, or platform payouts catch up.
items.best_outcome: The user can see whether their ad spend plan is safe, risky, or likely to create a cash gap.
items.primary_cta: Run the Ad Spend Cash Flow Calculator
items.pricing_or_access_note: Access depends on the GPT visibility and ChatGPT account availability.
items.notes: Primary CTA should point to the Custom GPT. Secondary CTA can point to funding application or ecommerce funding comparison.

items.name: AI Agent Library Builder
items.one_sentence_description: Helps turn agent ideas into repo-ready specs, skills, knowledge bases, prompts, schemas, and static pages.
items.main_pain_solved: Agent ideas often stay scattered instead of becoming structured, reusable, deployable assets.
items.best_outcome: The user receives a file-ready package for agents, skills, prompts, schemas, pages, or knowledge-base folders.
items.notes: Potential internal GPT for generating and auditing AI Agent Library repo assets.
